16	"""MoE forward-execution schedulers.
17	
18	ConfigurableMoE owns module lifecycle (backend creation, attribute sync,
19	weight loading delegation, comm strategy lifetime, EPLB init, repeat_idx
20	advancement, DWDP record). Schedulers own forward-time decisions: padding,
21	chunking, communication ordering, EPLB hook ordering, and backend
22	``run_moe`` invocation.
23	
24	Schedulers are read-mostly with respect to ``ConfigurableMoE``: they may
25	call ``moe.X`` helpers and read ``moe.<attribute>``, but must NOT write
26	``moe.repeat_idx`` (advanced by the wrapper) and must only mutate
27	``moe.comm`` through ``moe.determine_communication_method`` (the documented
28	AllToAll -> AllGather fallback). See MOE_SCHEDULER_DESIGN.md for the full
29	contract.
30	
31	Two schedulers exist today, distinguished by where the cross-rank EP
32	exchange runs:
33	
34	- ``ExternalCommMoEScheduler``: comm lives outside the MoE kernel; the
35	  scheduler issues ``Communication.dispatch`` / ``Communication.combine``
36	  from the host with per-chunk EPLB hooks and optional multi-stream
37	  chunk overlap.
38	- ``FusedCommMoEScheduler``: comm is fused into the backend's fused
39	  kernel (DeepGEMM ``fp8_fp4_mega_moe``-style "MegaMoE") via NVLink
40	  SymmBuffer; no host comm, lockstep chunk launches.
41	"""
42	
43	from __future__ import annotations
44	
45	from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
46	from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
47	
48	import torch
49	
50	from tensorrt_llm._torch.expert_statistic import ExpertStatistic
51	from tensorrt_llm._torch.utils import EventType, Fp4QuantizedTensor
52	from tensorrt_llm.tools.layer_wise_benchmarks import get_calibrator
53	
54	from .communication import DeepEP, DeepEPLowLatency, NcclEP, NVLinkOneSided, NVLinkTwoSided
55	from .communication.nvlink_two_sided_flashinfer import NVLinkTwoSidedFlashinfer
56	from .fused_moe_cute_dsl import CuteDslFusedMoE
57	from .fused_moe_cutlass import CutlassFusedMoE, raise_moe_lora_multichunk_unsupported
58	from .fused_moe_deepgemm import DeepGemmFusedMoE
59	from .fused_moe_densegemm import DenseGEMMFusedMoE
60	from .fused_moe_marlin import MarlinFusedMoE
61	from .fused_moe_trtllm_gen import TRTLLMGenFusedMoE
62	from .interface import MoESchedulerKind
63	
64	__all__ = [
65	    "MoEScheduler",
66	    "ExternalCommMoEScheduler",
67	    "FusedCommMoEScheduler",
68	    "create_moe_scheduler",
69	]
70	
71	if TYPE_CHECKING:
72	    from .configurable_moe import ConfigurableMoE
73	
74	
75	class MoEScheduler(ABC):
76	    """Forward-execution strategy for ConfigurableMoE.
77	
78	    Stateless w.r.t. model configuration. Holds a back-reference to the
79	    owning ``ConfigurableMoE`` and reads (but does not write) wrapper
80	    state. See module docstring for the contract.
81	    """
82	
83	    def __init__(self, moe: "ConfigurableMoE") -> None:
84	        self.moe = moe
85	
86	    @abstractmethod
87	    def forward(
88	        self,
89	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
90	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
91	        *,
92	        do_finalize: bool,
93	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
94	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
95	        use_dp_padding: Optional[bool],
96	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
97	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
98	    ) -> torch.Tensor: ...
99	
100	
101	# ============================================================================
102	# External-comm scheduler
103	# ============================================================================
104	
105	
106	class ExternalCommMoEScheduler(MoEScheduler):
107	    """External-comm forward path: host-side dispatch/combine + per-chunk EPLB hooks.
108	
109	    Steps:
110	
111	    1. Fill ``all_rank_num_tokens`` with local token count when missing.
112	    2. Apply DP padding metadata when requested.
113	    3. Compute ``num_chunks`` via ``moe.calculate_num_chunks``.
114	    4. Validate / fallback comm strategy via
115	       ``moe.determine_communication_method``.
116	    5. Dispatch to single- or multi-chunk implementation.
117	    6. Truncate DP padding from outputs.
118	
119	    ``repeat_idx`` advancement and DWDP record are owned by
120	    ``ConfigurableMoE.forward_impl`` after the scheduler returns.
121	
122	    ``TRTLLM_ENABLE_DUMMY_ALLREDUCE`` is a performance-debug knob that
123	    injects symmetric synchronization around dispatch/combine. It helps
124	    separate MoE communication timing from rank skew or load-imbalance
125	    artifacts when analyzing traces.
126	    """
127	
128	    def forward(
129	        self,
130	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
131	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
132	        *,
133	        do_finalize: bool,
134	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
135	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
136	        use_dp_padding: Optional[bool],
137	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
138	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
139	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
140	        moe = self.moe
141	
142	        # ========== Step 1: Handle padding ==========
143	        if all_rank_num_tokens is None:
144	            all_rank_num_tokens = [x.shape[0]]
145	
146	        all_rank_max_num_tokens = max(all_rank_num_tokens)
147	
148	        if use_dp_padding:
149	            all_rank_num_tokens_padded = [all_rank_max_num_tokens] * len(all_rank_num_tokens)
150	        else:
151	            all_rank_num_tokens_padded = all_rank_num_tokens
152	
153	        # ========== Step 2: Determine communication method ==========
154	        num_chunks = moe.calculate_num_chunks(all_rank_num_tokens_padded)
155	
156	        if (
157	            num_chunks > 1
158	            and moe.backend.__class__ == CutlassFusedMoE
159	            and moe.backend._moe_lora_active(lora_params)
160	        ):
161	            raise_moe_lora_multichunk_unsupported(num_chunks)
162	
163	        # ========== 0-token rank deadlock fix ==========
164	        # When some ranks have 0 tokens in single-chunk forward with collective comm,
165	        # those ranks hang in CUDA kernels (e.g. NVFP4 quantize_input with 0-row tensor)
166	        # before reaching moe.comm.dispatch(), causing NCCL AllGather deadlock on
167	        # non-zero ranks. Fix: activate DP padding uniformly across all ranks so every
168	        # rank uses sizes=None (uniform allgather) and pads x/router_logits to max_tokens.
169	        # Mirrors the empty-chunk substitution in _forward_multiple_chunks (line ~597-620).
170	        # Existing truncation at Step 4 discards dummy-token outputs automatically.
171	        # NOTE: kept after the multi-chunk rejection above so unit tests that stub `moe`
172	        # with a minimal namespace (no `.comm`/`.use_dp`) still exercise that path; only
173	        # relevant to single-chunk collective comm anyway.
174	        if (
175	            moe.comm is not None
176	            and moe.use_dp
177	            and all_rank_max_num_tokens > 0
178	            and not use_dp_padding
179	            and any(t == 0 for t in all_rank_num_tokens_padded)
180	        ):
181	            use_dp_padding = True
182	            all_rank_num_tokens_padded = [all_rank_max_num_tokens] * len(all_rank_num_tokens)
183	            local_n = x.shape[0]
184	            if local_n < all_rank_max_num_tokens:
185	                pad = all_rank_max_num_tokens - local_n
186	                x = torch.cat([x, x.new_zeros((pad, x.shape[1]))], dim=0)
187	                router_logits = torch.cat(
188	                    [router_logits, router_logits.new_zeros((pad, router_logits.shape[1]))], dim=0
189	                )
190	
191	        # May fall back AllToAll -> AllGather; this is the only sanctioned
192	        # mutation of ``moe.comm`` from a scheduler.
193	        moe.determine_communication_method(all_rank_num_tokens_padded, num_chunks)
194	
195	        # ========== Step 3: Execute MoE computation ==========
196	        if num_chunks == 1:
197	            outputs = self._forward_single_chunk(
198	                x,
199	                router_logits,
200	                output_dtype,
201	                all_rank_num_tokens_padded,
202	                use_dp_padding,
203	                do_finalize,
204	                input_ids,
205	                lora_params=lora_params,
206	            )
207	        else:
208	            outputs = self._forward_multiple_chunks(
209	                x,
210	                router_logits,
211	                num_chunks,
212	                output_dtype,
213	                all_rank_num_tokens_padded,
214	                use_dp_padding,
215	                do_finalize,
216	                input_ids,
217	                lora_params=lora_params,
218	            )
219	
220	        # ========== Step 4: Truncate DP padding ==========
221	        if moe.use_dp and moe.parallel_size > 1:
222	            outputs = outputs[: all_rank_num_tokens[moe.mapping.tp_rank]]
223	
224	        return outputs
225	
226	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
227	    # Communication-strategy probes (used by _forward_chunk_impl to gate
228	    # NVLink-specific EPLB stat-gather paths)
229	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
230	    def _is_using_nvlink_two_sided(self) -> bool:
231	        return isinstance(self.moe.comm, (NVLinkTwoSided, NVLinkTwoSidedFlashinfer))
232	
233	    def _is_using_nvlink_one_sided(self) -> bool:
234	        return isinstance(self.moe.comm, NVLinkOneSided)
235	
236	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
237	    # DeepGemm workspace allocation
238	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
239	    def _prepare_workspace_deepgemm(
240	        self,
241	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
242	        all_rank_num_tokens: List[int],
243	    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
244	        """Single-chunk workspace for DeepGemmFusedMoE; otherwise ``None``.
245	
246	        Multi-chunk execution uses ``_prepare_workspaces_for_chunk`` instead.
247	        """
248	        moe = self.moe
249	        if not isinstance(moe.backend, DeepGemmFusedMoE):
250	            return None
251	
252	        num_rows = x.shape[0]
253	        if moe.use_dp and moe.comm is not None:
254	            # Communication path padding: dispatch outputs are
255	            # ``[num_dp_ranks * max_tokens_per_rank, ...]`` (or expert-major for
256	            # DeepEPLowLatency). Workspace must cover that footprint.
257	            if isinstance(moe.comm, DeepEPLowLatency):
258	                num_rows = moe.num_slots * max(all_rank_num_tokens)
259	            else:
260	                num_rows = moe._dp_padded_num_rows(all_rank_num_tokens)
261	
262	        workspaces = moe.backend.get_workspaces([num_rows])
263	        return workspaces[0]
264	
265	    def _prepare_workspaces_for_chunk(
266	        self,
267	        all_rank_num_tokens_list: List[Optional[List[int]]],
268	        chunk_size_list: List[int],
269	        use_multi_stream: bool,
270	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
271	        """Multi-chunk workspaces for DeepGemmFusedMoE; ``(None, None)`` otherwise.
272	
273	        Single-chunk execution uses ``_prepare_workspace_deepgemm`` instead.
274	        """
275	        moe = self.moe
276	        workspace_0 = None
277	        workspace_1 = None
278	
279	        if not isinstance(moe.backend, DeepGemmFusedMoE):
280	            return workspace_0, workspace_1
281	
282	        # Always need at least workspace_0; reuse chunk_0 size for workspace_1
283	        # since chunk 0 is always >= subsequent chunks under split_chunk.
284	        # Mirror ``_prepare_workspace_deepgemm``: DeepEPLowLatency dispatches
285	        # expert-major outputs sized ``num_slots * max_tokens_per_rank`` per
286	        # rank (one shard per slot), while other comms produce
287	        # ``num_dp_ranks * max_tokens_per_rank``. Using the wrong formula
288	        # under-allocates the workspace for DeepEPLowLatency multi-chunk
289	        # runs and is caught by ``DeepGemmFusedMoE.run_moe``.
290	        if moe.use_dp and all_rank_num_tokens_list[0] is not None:
291	            max_tokens = max(all_rank_num_tokens_list[0])
292	            if isinstance(moe.comm, DeepEPLowLatency):
293	                chunk_size_0 = moe.num_slots * max_tokens
294	            else:
295	                chunk_size_0 = moe._dp_padded_num_rows(all_rank_num_tokens_list[0])
296	        else:
297	            chunk_size_0 = chunk_size_list[0]
298	        workspace_chunk_sizes = [chunk_size_0]
299	
300	        if use_multi_stream:
301	            workspace_chunk_sizes.append(chunk_size_0)
302	
303	        workspaces = moe.backend.get_workspaces(workspace_chunk_sizes)
304	        workspace_0 = workspaces[0]
305	        if use_multi_stream:
306	            workspace_1 = workspaces[1]
307	
308	        return workspace_0, workspace_1
309	
310	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
311	    # Single / multi chunk dispatch
312	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
313	    def _forward_single_chunk(
314	        self,
315	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
316	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
317	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
318	        all_rank_num_tokens: List[int],
319	        use_dp_padding: Optional[bool],
320	        do_finalize: bool = True,
321	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
322	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
323	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
324	        moe = self.moe
325	        is_first_call = moe.repeat_idx == 0
326	        is_last_call = moe.repeat_idx == moe.repeat_count - 1
327	
328	        workspace = self._prepare_workspace_deepgemm(x, all_rank_num_tokens)
329	
330	        return self._forward_chunk_impl(
331	            x,
332	            router_logits,
333	            output_dtype,
334	            all_rank_num_tokens,
335	            use_dp_padding,
336	            is_first_call,
337	            is_last_call,
338	            do_finalize,
339	            workspace=workspace,
340	            input_ids=input_ids,
341	            lora_params=lora_params,
342	        )
343	
344	    def _forward_chunk_impl(
345	        self,
346	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
347	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
348	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
349	        all_rank_num_tokens: List[int],
350	        use_dp_padding: bool,
351	        is_first_call: bool,
352	        is_last_call: bool,
353	        do_finalize: bool = True,
354	        workspace: Optional[dict] = None,
355	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
356	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
357	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
358	        """Unified per-chunk execution flow for all external-comm backends.
359	
360	        Flow:
361	          1. EPLB - Start wait GPU stage (first call only, dynamic only)
362	          2. Apply routing (only if backend supports routing separation)
363	          3. EPLB - Update statistics and route (only if EPLB enabled)
364	          4. Communication prepare phase (NVLINK two-sided only)
365	          5. Quantization + dispatch (pre/post-quant adaptive ordering)
366	          6. backend.run_moe
367	          7. EPLB - Start CPU stage (last call only, dynamic only)
368	          8. Communication combine
369	          9. EPLB - Done CPU stage (last call only, dynamic only)
370	        """
371	        moe = self.moe
372	
373	        # ========== Step 1: EPLB - Start wait GPU stage ==========
374	        moe._load_balancer_start_wait_gpu_stage(is_first_call)
375	
376	        # ========== Step 2: Apply routing ==========
377	        # External dispatch (Step 5) sends per-token expert/scale payloads, so
378	        # routing must be precomputed whenever a comm strategy is active — even
379	        # for backends whose run_moe can otherwise route internally from
380	        # router_logits (e.g. MarlinFusedMoE under attention-DP + EP).
381	        requires_separated_routing = (
382	            moe.backend._supports_load_balancer()
383	            or moe.routing_method.requires_separated_routing
384	            or moe.comm is not None
385	        )
386	        if requires_separated_routing:
387	            # Separated routing: ConfigurableMoE calls routing_method
388	            token_selected_experts, token_final_scales = moe.routing_method.apply(
389	                router_logits, input_ids
390	            )
391	
392	            token_selected_experts = token_selected_experts.to(torch.int32)
393	
394	            assert token_selected_experts.shape[1] == moe.routing_method.experts_per_token
395	            assert token_selected_experts.shape == token_final_scales.shape
396	            # CutlassFusedMoE and DenseGEMMFusedMoE expect float32; TRTLLMGen expects bfloat16
397	            if isinstance(moe.backend, (CutlassFusedMoE, DenseGEMMFusedMoE)):
398	                assert token_final_scales.dtype == torch.float32
399	            assert token_selected_experts.dtype == torch.int32
400	
401	            if token_final_scales is not None and isinstance(moe.backend, TRTLLMGenFusedMoE):
402	                token_final_scales = token_final_scales.to(torch.bfloat16)
403	
404	            # apply_router_weight_on_input: fuse top-k weight onto x
405	            if moe.apply_router_weight_on_input:
406	                assert x.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn, (
407	                    "Current workaround for apply_router_weight_on_input does not support fp8 input"
408	                )
409	                x = x * token_final_scales.to(x.dtype)
410	                # These strategies need non-None token_final_scales, so feed
411	                # all-ones after folding the real weights into x.
412	                if isinstance(moe.comm, (DeepEP, DeepEPLowLatency, NcclEP)):
413	                    token_final_scales = torch.ones_like(token_final_scales)
414	                else:
415	                    token_final_scales = None
416	
417	        else:
418	            # Fused routing: backend handles routing internally; EPLB must be off.
419	            assert not moe._using_load_balancer(), (
420	                f"EPLB is enabled but backend {moe.backend.__class__.__name__} "
421	                f"has fused routing (does not support routing separation)"
422	            )
423	            token_selected_experts = None
424	            token_final_scales = None
425	
426	        # ========== Step 3: EPLB - Update statistics and route ==========
427	        if moe.layer_load_balancer and token_selected_experts is not None:
428	            moe._load_balancer_done_wait_gpu_stage(is_first_call)
429	
430	            # NVLink two-sided / one-sided gather EPLB stats themselves; skip the
431	            # base helper's own AllReduce in that case (ignore_allreduce=True).
432	            ignore_allreduce = (
433	                self._is_using_nvlink_two_sided() or self._is_using_nvlink_one_sided()
434	            )
435	            moe._load_balancer_update_statistic(
436	                token_selected_experts,
437	                is_first_call,
438	                is_last_call,
439	                ignore_allreduce=ignore_allreduce,
440	            )
441	
442	            token_selected_slots = moe._load_balancer_route(token_selected_experts, moe.use_dp)
443	        else:
444	            token_selected_slots = token_selected_experts
445	
446	        if token_selected_slots is not None:
447	            ExpertStatistic.set_layer(moe.layer_idx)
448	            ExpertStatistic.maybe_add_info(moe.num_slots, token_selected_slots)
449	        token_selected_slots = get_calibrator().maybe_collect_or_replay_slots(
450	            moe.num_slots, token_selected_slots
451	        )
452	
453	        # ========== Step 4: Communication prepare phase (NVLINK two-sided only) ==========
454	        local_statistic_tensor_for_dispatch = None
455	        eplb_dispatch_kwargs = {}
456	        should_update_eplb_after_dispatch = False
457	        if self._is_using_nvlink_two_sided():
458	            local_statistic_tensor = None
459	            if is_last_call:
460	                local_statistic_tensor = moe._load_balancer_get_local_statistic_tensor()
461	
462	            # prepare_dispatch stores alltoall_info in _dispatch_state and returns gathered_stats
463	            gathered_stats = moe.comm.prepare_dispatch(
464	                token_selected_slots, all_rank_num_tokens, local_statistic_tensor
465	            )
466	
467	            if gathered_stats is not None:
468	                gathered_stats = gathered_stats.view((moe.mapping.moe_ep_size, moe.num_experts))
469	                moe._load_balancer_update_statistic_with_gathered_statistic(gathered_stats)
470	        # NVLinkOneSided gathers EPLB stats inside dispatch, not prepare_dispatch
471	        elif self._is_using_nvlink_one_sided():
472	            if moe.layer_load_balancer and is_last_call:
473	                local_statistic_tensor_for_dispatch = (
474	                    moe._load_balancer_get_local_statistic_tensor()
475	                )
476	            if local_statistic_tensor_for_dispatch is not None:
477	                eplb_dispatch_kwargs["eplb_local_stats"] = local_statistic_tensor_for_dispatch
478	                should_update_eplb_after_dispatch = True
479	
480	        # ========== Step 5: Quantization + dispatch (pre/post-quant adaptive ordering) ==========
481	        if moe.comm is not None:
482	            supports_post_quant = moe.comm.supports_post_quant_dispatch()
483	
484	            # Debug: optional dummy AllReduce to break load-balancing artifacts
485	            if moe.enable_dummy_allreduce:
486	                moe.dummy_allreduce()
487	
488	            dispatch_kwargs = dict(eplb_dispatch_kwargs)
489	            if isinstance(moe.comm, DeepEP) and isinstance(moe.backend, TRTLLMGenFusedMoE):
490	                dispatch_kwargs["enable_sanitize_expert_ids"] = True
491	
492	            if supports_post_quant:
493	                # Quantize -> Dispatch
494	                x, x_sf = moe.backend.quantize_input(x)
495	
496	                # W4AFP8 + DeepEPLowLatency needs pre_quant_scale_1; other strategies
497	                # absorb the kwarg via **kwargs so unconditional passing is safe.
498	                if hasattr(moe, "quant_scales") and moe.quant_scales is not None:
499	                    if hasattr(moe.quant_scales, "pre_quant_scale_1"):
500	                        dispatch_kwargs["pre_quant_scale"] = moe.quant_scales.pre_quant_scale_1
501	                x, x_sf, token_selected_slots, token_final_scales = moe.comm.dispatch(
502	                    hidden_states=x,
503	                    hidden_states_sf=x_sf,
504	                    token_selected_slots=token_selected_slots,
505	                    token_final_scales=token_final_scales,
506	                    all_rank_num_tokens=all_rank_num_tokens,
507	                    use_dp_padding=use_dp_padding,
508	                    **dispatch_kwargs,
509	                )
510	                if should_update_eplb_after_dispatch:
511	                    gathered_stats = moe.comm.get_eplb_gathered_statistics()
512	                    moe._load_balancer_update_statistic_with_gathered_statistic(gathered_stats)
513	            else:
514	                # Dispatch -> Quantize
515	                x, x_sf, token_selected_slots, token_final_scales = moe.comm.dispatch(
516	                    hidden_states=x,
517	                    hidden_states_sf=None,  # not quantized yet
518	                    token_selected_slots=token_selected_slots,
519	                    token_final_scales=token_final_scales,
520	                    all_rank_num_tokens=all_rank_num_tokens,
521	                    use_dp_padding=use_dp_padding,
522	                    **dispatch_kwargs,
523	                )
524	                x, x_sf = moe.backend.quantize_input(x, post_quant_comm=False)
525	        else:
526	            # No comm: just quantize
527	            x, x_sf = moe.backend.quantize_input(x, post_quant_comm=False)
528	
529	        # ========== Step 6: MoE computation ==========
530	        # If EPLB is enabled, token_selected_slots is slot ids; otherwise expert ids.
531	        final_hidden_states = moe.backend.run_moe(
532	            x=x,
533	            token_selected_experts=token_selected_slots,
534	            token_final_scales=token_final_scales,
535	            x_sf=x_sf,
536	            **self._get_backend_kwargs(
537	                router_logits,
538	                do_finalize,
539	                all_rank_num_tokens,
540	                output_dtype,
541	                x,
542	                workspace,
543	                lora_params=lora_params,
544	            ),
545	        )
546	
547	        # ========== Step 7: EPLB - Start CPU stage ==========
548	        moe._load_balancer_start_set_cpu_stage(is_last_call)
549	
550	        # ========== Step 8: Communication combine ==========
551	        if moe.comm is not None:
552	            if moe.enable_dummy_allreduce:
553	                moe.dummy_allreduce()
554	            all_rank_max_num_tokens = max(all_rank_num_tokens)
555	            final_hidden_states = moe.comm.combine(
556	                final_hidden_states,
557	                all_rank_max_num_tokens=all_rank_max_num_tokens,
558	            )
559	        else:
560	            # Non-comm path: attention TP or single rank; only AllReduce if reduce_results
561	            if moe.parallel_size > 1 and moe.reduce_results:
562	                final_hidden_states = moe.all_reduce(final_hidden_states)
563	
564	        # ========== Step 9: EPLB - Done CPU stage ==========
565	        moe._load_balancer_done_set_cpu_stage(is_last_call)
566	
567	        return final_hidden_states

569	    def _forward_multiple_chunks(
570	        self,
571	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
572	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
573	        num_chunks: int,
574	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
575	        all_rank_num_tokens: List[int],
576	        use_dp_padding: Optional[bool],
577	        do_finalize: bool = True,
578	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
579	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
580	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
581	        """Multiple-chunk path with optional aux-stream overlap."""
582	        moe = self.moe
583	
584	        # ========== Chunk preparation ==========
585	        if moe.use_dp:
586	            # DP: need all ranks' token counts for reducescatter
587	            all_rank_chunk_size_list = [
588	                moe.split_chunk(val, num_chunks) for val in all_rank_num_tokens
589	            ]
590	            all_rank_num_tokens_list = [
591	                [val[idx_chunk] for val in all_rank_chunk_size_list]
592	                for idx_chunk in range(num_chunks)
593	            ]
594	            chunk_size_list = all_rank_chunk_size_list[moe.rank]
595	
596	            # AllToAll cannot consume an all-zero rank; substitute 1 token.
597	            if moe.enable_alltoall:
598	                all_rank_num_tokens_list = [
599	                    [1 if val == 0 else val for val in val_list]
600	                    for val_list in all_rank_num_tokens_list
601	                ]
602	        else:
603	            all_rank_num_tokens_list = [None] * num_chunks
604	            chunk_size_list = moe.split_chunk(x.shape[0], num_chunks)
605	
606	        x_list = x.split(chunk_size_list)
607	        router_logits_list = router_logits.split(chunk_size_list)
608	        input_ids_list = (
609	            input_ids.split(chunk_size_list) if input_ids is not None else [None] * num_chunks
610	        )
611	
612	        use_multi_stream = not moe.enable_alltoall and moe.aux_stream is not None
613	
614	        # ========== Setup auxiliary stream ==========
615	        if use_multi_stream:
616	            moe.event_dict[EventType.Main].record()
617	            with torch.cuda.stream(moe.aux_stream):
618	                moe.event_dict[EventType.Main].wait()
619	
620	        # ========== DeepGemm workspaces ==========
621	        workspace_0, workspace_1 = self._prepare_workspaces_for_chunk(
622	            all_rank_num_tokens_list, chunk_size_list, use_multi_stream
623	        )
624	
625	        # ========== Empty-chunk substitution (DP only) ==========
626	        chunked_used = torch.ones(num_chunks, dtype=torch.bool)
627	        if moe.use_dp:
628	            # The split heuristic guarantees chunk 0 has >= 1 token, so it can
629	            # stand in for any empty chunk on this rank. Without substitution,
630	            # the per-chunk dispatch would launch with 0-token shape and the
631	            # peers would see a barrier mismatch.
632	            assert x_list[0].numel() != 0, "chunk 0 shouldn't be empty"
633	            x_list = list(x_list)
634	            router_logits_list = list(router_logits_list)
635	            input_ids_list = list(input_ids_list)
636	            for idx_chunk in range(num_chunks):
637	                _x = x_list[idx_chunk]
638	                if _x.numel() == 0:
639	                    chunked_used[idx_chunk] = False
640	                    x_list[idx_chunk] = x_list[0]
641	                    router_logits_list[idx_chunk] = router_logits_list[0]
642	                    input_ids_list[idx_chunk] = input_ids_list[0]
643	                    all_rank_num_tokens_list[idx_chunk][moe.mapping.tp_rank] = (
644	                        all_rank_num_tokens_list[0][moe.mapping.tp_rank]
645	                    )
646	            x_list = tuple(x_list)
647	            router_logits_list = tuple(router_logits_list)
648	            input_ids_list = tuple(input_ids_list)
649	
650	        # ========== Execute chunking with overlap ==========
651	        outputs_list = []
652	        for idx_chunk, (x_chunk, router_logits_chunk, input_ids_chunk) in enumerate(
653	            zip(x_list, router_logits_list, input_ids_list)
654	        ):
655	            is_first_call = idx_chunk == 0 and moe.repeat_idx == 0
656	            is_last_call = idx_chunk == num_chunks - 1 and moe.repeat_idx == moe.repeat_count - 1
657	
658	            if use_multi_stream:
659	                # Alternate streams; each chunk fully owns its (forward + reducescatter).
660	                # Even chunks use aux_stream so chunk 0 is isolated from outer main-stream traffic.
661	                if idx_chunk % 2 == 0:
662	                    with torch.cuda.stream(moe.aux_stream):
663	                        outputs = self._forward_chunk_impl(
664	                            x_chunk,
665	                            router_logits_chunk,
666	                            output_dtype,
667	                            all_rank_num_tokens_list[idx_chunk],
668	                            use_dp_padding,
669	                            is_first_call,
670	                            is_last_call,
671	                            do_finalize,
672	                            workspace=workspace_0,
673	                            input_ids=input_ids_chunk,
674	                            lora_params=lora_params,
675	                        )
676	                else:
677	                    outputs = self._forward_chunk_impl(
678	                        x_chunk,
679	                        router_logits_chunk,
680	                        output_dtype,
681	                        all_rank_num_tokens_list[idx_chunk],
682	                        use_dp_padding,
683	                        is_first_call,
684	                        is_last_call,
685	                        do_finalize,
686	                        workspace=workspace_1,
687	                        input_ids=input_ids_chunk,
688	                        lora_params=lora_params,
689	                    )
690	            else:
691	                outputs = self._forward_chunk_impl(
692	                    x_chunk,
693	                    router_logits_chunk,
694	                    output_dtype,
695	                    all_rank_num_tokens_list[idx_chunk],
696	                    use_dp_padding,
697	                    is_first_call,
698	                    is_last_call,
699	                    do_finalize,
700	                    workspace=workspace_0,
701	                    input_ids=input_ids_chunk,
702	                    lora_params=lora_params,
703	                )
704	
705	            if chunked_used[idx_chunk]:
706	                outputs_list.append(outputs)
707	
708	        # ========== Wait for auxiliary stream to complete ==========
709	        if use_multi_stream:
710	            with torch.cuda.stream(moe.aux_stream):
711	                moe.event_dict[EventType.MoeChunkingOverlap].record()
712	            moe.event_dict[EventType.MoeChunkingOverlap].wait()
713	
714	        outputs = torch.cat(outputs_list)
715	        return outputs

720	    def _get_nvlink_onesided_moe_output(
721	        self,
722	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
723	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
724	    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
725	        """Workspace-backed output buffer for NVLinkOneSided combine, or None.
726	
727	        Only meaningful when ``moe.comm`` is NVLinkOneSided AND the backend
728	        supports payload-in-workspace combine. Returns None for all other
729	        comm strategies; callers should always set the resulting kwarg
730	        unconditionally and let backends ignore None.
731	        """
732	        moe = self.moe
733	        if not isinstance(moe.comm, NVLinkOneSided):
734	            return None
735	
736	        if not moe.backend.supports_moe_output_in_alltoall_workspace():
737	            # Backend opts out: keep payload off the workspace path.
738	            moe.comm.payload_in_workspace = False
739	            return None
740	
741	        workspace_dtype = output_dtype
742	        if isinstance(moe.backend, TRTLLMGenFusedMoE):
743	            # TRTLLMGen sentinel for unfilled rows; bf16 workspace is the
744	            # combine reduction precision used by the kernel.
745	            moe.comm.invalid_token_expert_id = -1
746	            workspace_dtype = torch.bfloat16
747	
748	        assert all_rank_num_tokens is not None, (
749	            "all_rank_num_tokens must be provided for NVLinkOneSided backend"
750	        )
751	        runtime_max_tokens_per_rank = max(all_rank_num_tokens)
752	
753	        moe_output = moe.comm.get_combine_payload_tensor_in_workspace(
754	            runtime_max_tokens_per_rank, moe.hidden_size, workspace_dtype
755	        )
756	
757	        # Toggle on for this forward; combine() reads this flag to decide
758	        # whether to emit into the workspace tensor.
759	        moe.comm.payload_in_workspace = True
760	        return moe_output

762	    def _get_backend_kwargs(
763	        self,
764	        router_logits: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
765	        do_finalize: bool = True,
766	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]] = None,
767	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,
768	        x: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
769	        workspace: Optional[dict] = None,
770	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
771	    ) -> Dict:
772	        """Backend-specific kwargs for ``backend.run_moe`` (external-comm only).
773	
774	        ``FusedCommMoEScheduler`` constructs its own kwargs and never
775	        calls this helper, so all branches here are EXTERNAL_COMM backends.
776	
777	        Backend-specific kwargs:
778	            - Cutlass: is_sf_swizzled, enable_alltoall, tuner_*, moe_output, lora_params
779	            - CuteDSL: enable_alltoall, moe_output
780	            - DeepGemm: workspace
781	            - TRTLLMGen: router_logits, do_finalize, moe_output
782	
783	        Only CutlassFusedMoE.run_moe accepts lora_params (routed-expert MoE LoRA
784	        is fused there), so it is set on the Cutlass branch alone.
785	        """
786	        moe = self.moe
787	        kwargs: Dict = {}
788	
789	        if moe.backend.__class__ == CutlassFusedMoE:
790	            # Pre-quant dispatch: SFs arrive swizzled; post-quant dispatch:
791	            # SFs arrive unswizzled. Backend uses this to skip a re-swizzle.
792	            supports_post_quant = moe.comm is not None and moe.comm.supports_post_quant_dispatch()
793	            kwargs["is_sf_swizzled"] = not supports_post_quant
794	            kwargs["output_dtype"] = output_dtype
795	            kwargs["lora_params"] = lora_params
796	
797	            # Tuner sees pre-alltoall token shapes so cached tactics from the
798	            # warmup (no-alltoall) phase still apply at runtime.
799	            kwargs["enable_alltoall"] = moe.enable_alltoall
800	            if moe.enable_alltoall:
801	                if all_rank_num_tokens is not None:
802	                    kwargs["tuner_num_tokens"] = sum(all_rank_num_tokens)
803	                else:
804	                    kwargs["tuner_num_tokens"] = (
805	                        x.shape[0] * moe.mapping.tp_size if x is not None else None
806	                    )
807	                kwargs["tuner_top_k"] = moe.routing_method.top_k
808	
809	            kwargs["moe_output"] = self._get_nvlink_onesided_moe_output(
810	                all_rank_num_tokens=all_rank_num_tokens, output_dtype=output_dtype
811	            )
812	
813	        elif moe.backend.__class__ == CuteDslFusedMoE:
814	            kwargs["enable_alltoall"] = moe.enable_alltoall
815	            kwargs["moe_output"] = self._get_nvlink_onesided_moe_output(
816	                all_rank_num_tokens=all_rank_num_tokens, output_dtype=output_dtype
817	            )
818	
819	        elif moe.backend.__class__ == DeepGemmFusedMoE:
820	            if workspace is not None:
821	                kwargs["workspace"] = workspace
822	
823	        elif moe.backend.__class__ == TRTLLMGenFusedMoE:
824	            # When the scheduler precomputes top-k for DP/load-balancer paths,
825	            # the backend must not route again.  Single-rank TRTLLMGen paths do
826	            # not get precomputed top-k, so they still need router_logits.
827	            router_logits_arg = None if moe.backend._supports_load_balancer() else router_logits
828	            kwargs["router_logits"] = router_logits_arg
829	            kwargs["do_finalize"] = do_finalize
830	            kwargs["moe_output"] = self._get_nvlink_onesided_moe_output(
831	                all_rank_num_tokens=all_rank_num_tokens, output_dtype=output_dtype
832	            )
833	
834	        elif moe.backend.__class__ == MarlinFusedMoE:
835	            kwargs["router_logits"] = router_logits
836	
837	        return kwargs

845	class FusedCommMoEScheduler(MoEScheduler):
846	    """Fused-comm scheduler: backend's fused kernel owns the EP exchange.
847	
848	    Invariants (see MOE_SCHEDULER_DESIGN.md / mega_moe/CHUNKING_DESIGN.md):
849	
850	    1. Reject ``Fp4QuantizedTensor`` activation; backend.quantize_input
851	       owns the BF16 -> FP8 conversion.
852	    2. Ignore ``use_dp_padding`` (no host-side cross-rank shape alignment).
853	    3. Use ``mapping.moe_ep_rank`` for local token count, not global rank.
854	    4. Strip ADP padding before splitting tensors.
855	    5. ``had_meta=False`` -> pass ``None`` per-chunk so inner falls back to
856	       ``num_tokens=x.shape[0]`` (avoids IndexError on moe_ep_rank>0).
857	    6. ``num_chunks = max(real_all_rank_num_tokens)`` (not the generic
858	       ``calculate_num_chunks``; that one falls back to ``sum()`` for
859	       ``comm is None`` and would diverge per rank).
860	    7. Launch every chunk on every EP rank, including zero-token chunks,
861	       so peers can cross the in-kernel NVLink barrier.
862	    8. No external Communication.dispatch / Communication.combine.
863	    9. No multi-stream chunk overlap.
864	
865	    ``repeat_idx`` advancement is done by ``ConfigurableMoE.forward_impl``
866	    after this scheduler returns. The scheduler must not rotate
867	    ``moe.repeat_idx``.
868	    """
869	
870	    def forward(
871	        self,
872	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
873	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
874	        *,
875	        do_finalize: bool,
876	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
877	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
878	        use_dp_padding: Optional[bool],
879	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor],
880	        lora_params: Optional[Dict] = None,
881	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
882	        """Sequential multi-chunk path for MegaMoE-style backends.
883	
884	        Single-chunk case is just ``num_chunks == 1`` -- no separate fast
885	        path. Invariants enforced here (see class docstring): identical
886	        ``num_chunks`` per rank computed from ``max()``, ADP padding
887	        stripped before splitting, zero-token chunks still launch the
888	        kernel for the cross-rank barrier.
889	        """
890	        del use_dp_padding  # MegaMoE has no host-side cross-rank shape alignment.
891	
892	        # Fused-comm (MegaMoE) backends cannot carry LoRA adapters; routed-expert
893	        # MoE LoRA is supported only on the CUTLASS backend. Reject rather than
894	        # silently ignore.
895	        if lora_params:
896	            raise NotImplementedError(
897	                "Routed-expert MoE LoRA is not supported by the fused-comm "
898	                "(MegaMoE) scheduler; only the CUTLASS backend supports it."
899	            )
900	
901	        if isinstance(x, Fp4QuantizedTensor):
902	            raise NotImplementedError(
903	                "Fused-comm MoE expects BF16 activation; "
904	                "quantization happens in backend.quantize_input."
905	            )
906	
907	        x_real, rl_real, input_ids_real, real_all_rank_num_tokens, ep_rank, had_meta = (
908	            self._strip_adp_padding(x, router_logits, input_ids, all_rank_num_tokens)
909	        )
910	        num_chunks, x_chunks, rl_chunks, all_rank_chunk_size_list = self._compute_chunk_layout(
911	            x_real, rl_real, real_all_rank_num_tokens, ep_rank
912	        )
913	        input_ids_chunks = []
914	        if input_ids_real is not None:
915	            chunk_size_list = all_rank_chunk_size_list[ep_rank]
916	            input_ids_chunks = (
917	                list(input_ids_real.split(chunk_size_list)) if input_ids_real.numel() > 0 else []
918	            )
919	        outputs = self._run_chunks(
920	            x_chunks,
921	            rl_chunks,
922	            input_ids_chunks,
923	            num_chunks=num_chunks,
924	            x_real=x_real,
925	            rl_real=rl_real,
926	            all_rank_chunk_size_list=all_rank_chunk_size_list,
927	            had_meta=had_meta,
928	            output_dtype=output_dtype,
929	            do_finalize=do_finalize,
930	        )
931	        if not outputs:
932	            cast_dtype = output_dtype if output_dtype is not None else x.dtype
933	            return x.new_empty((0, x.shape[1]), dtype=cast_dtype)
934	        if len(outputs) == 1:
935	            return outputs[0]
936	        return torch.cat(outputs, dim=0)
937	
938	    def _strip_adp_padding(
939	        self,
940	        x: torch.Tensor,
941	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
942	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor],
943	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
944	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor], List[int], int, bool]:
945	        """Slice ADP padding off ``x`` / ``router_logits`` using moe_ep_rank.
946	
947	        SymmBuffer exchange is EP-scoped, so we index the per-rank token count
948	        via ``moe.mapping.moe_ep_rank``, not ``self.rank``. ``had_meta`` lets
949	        the per-chunk impl fall back to ``num_tokens=x.shape[0]`` (avoids
950	        ``[len-1 list][moe_ep_rank>0]`` IndexError when no metadata is
951	        provided, e.g. dummy / single-rank forwards).
952	        """
953	        moe = self.moe
954	        had_meta = all_rank_num_tokens is not None
955	        if had_meta:
956	            # Force plain Python int: downstream torch.Tensor.split and range()
957	            # reject torch 0-d tensor / numpy scalar elements, and the public
958	            # ``Optional[List[int]]`` type hint is not runtime-enforced.
959	            real_all_rank_num_tokens = [int(v) for v in all_rank_num_tokens]
960	            ep_rank = moe.mapping.moe_ep_rank
961	        else:
962	            real_all_rank_num_tokens = [int(x.shape[0])]
963	            ep_rank = 0
964	        real_local = real_all_rank_num_tokens[ep_rank]
965	        assert real_local <= x.shape[0], (
966	            f"real_local ({real_local}) > x.shape[0] ({x.shape[0]}); "
967	            "all_rank_num_tokens may not be indexed correctly."
968	        )
969	        # ADP padding stripped before split, else trailing rows silently
970	        # drift into chunk-0 or torch.split shape-errors.
971	        x_real = x[:real_local]
972	        rl_real = router_logits[:real_local]
973	        input_ids_real = input_ids[:real_local] if input_ids is not None else None
974	        return x_real, rl_real, input_ids_real, real_all_rank_num_tokens, ep_rank, had_meta
975	
976	    def _compute_chunk_layout(
977	        self,
978	        x_real: torch.Tensor,
979	        rl_real: torch.Tensor,
980	        real_all_rank_num_tokens: List[int],
981	        ep_rank: int,
982	    ) -> Tuple[int, List[torch.Tensor], List[torch.Tensor], List[List[int]]]:
983	        """Compute per-rank/per-chunk shape and the actual tensor splits.
984	
985	        ``num_chunks`` uses ``max()``, not ``moe.calculate_num_chunks``: the
986	        latter falls back to ``sum()`` when ``comm is None`` and would diverge
987	        per rank, breaking the in-kernel cross-rank barrier (class invariant 6).
988	        ``... else 0`` defends against an empty meta list (caller passing
989	        ``[]`` instead of ``None``); ``max([])`` would otherwise raise.
990	
991	        ``all_rank_chunk_size_list[r][c]`` = tokens rank r contributes to
992	        chunk c. ``split_chunk`` evenly partitions ``v`` into exactly
993	        ``num_chunks`` pieces (zero-padded when v < num_chunks, including
994	        v == 0), so every row has the same length and ``chunk_size_list``
995	        below is this rank's row.
996	        """
997	        moe = self.moe
998	        real_local = real_all_rank_num_tokens[ep_rank]
999	
1000	        max_real = max(real_all_rank_num_tokens) if real_all_rank_num_tokens else 0
1001	        num_chunks = max(
1002	            1,
1003	            (max_real + moe.moe_max_num_tokens - 1) // moe.moe_max_num_tokens,
1004	        )
1005	
1006	        all_rank_chunk_size_list = [
1007	            moe.split_chunk(v, num_chunks) for v in real_all_rank_num_tokens
1008	        ]
1009	        chunk_size_list = all_rank_chunk_size_list[ep_rank]
1010	        # ``else []`` shortcut for real_local == 0: equivalent to
1011	        # x_real.split([0]*num_chunks) but skips the no-op torch call. The
1012	        # zero-token fallback in ``_run_chunks`` then fires for every chunk.
1013	        x_chunks = list(x_real.split(chunk_size_list)) if real_local > 0 else []
1014	        rl_chunks = list(rl_real.split(chunk_size_list)) if real_local > 0 else []
1015	        return num_chunks, x_chunks, rl_chunks, all_rank_chunk_size_list
1016	
1017	    def _run_chunks(
1018	        self,
1019	        x_chunks: List[torch.Tensor],
1020	        rl_chunks: List[torch.Tensor],
1021	        input_ids_chunks: List[torch.Tensor],
1022	        *,
1023	        num_chunks: int,
1024	        x_real: torch.Tensor,
1025	        rl_real: torch.Tensor,
1026	        all_rank_chunk_size_list: List[List[int]],
1027	        had_meta: bool,
1028	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
1029	        do_finalize: bool,
1030	    ) -> List[torch.Tensor]:
1031	        """Drive the per-chunk kernel launches, padding zero-token chunks.
1032	
1033	        Stage hooks + AllReduce only fire at the (first|last) chunk of the
1034	        (first|last) repeat, matching the external-comm path. The
1035	        ``idx_chunk >= len(x_chunks)`` branch only triggers when
1036	        ``real_local == 0`` (this rank has no tokens but peers do): class
1037	        invariant 7 says launch every chunk on every EP rank so the in-kernel
1038	        NVLink barrier (SymmBuffer collective) can synchronize.
1039	        """
1040	        moe = self.moe
1041	        outputs: List[torch.Tensor] = []
1042	        for idx_chunk in range(num_chunks):
1043	            is_first_call = idx_chunk == 0 and moe.repeat_idx == 0
1044	            is_last_call = idx_chunk == num_chunks - 1 and moe.repeat_idx == moe.repeat_count - 1
1045	
1046	            if idx_chunk < len(x_chunks):
1047	                x_chunk = x_chunks[idx_chunk]
1048	                rl_chunk = rl_chunks[idx_chunk]
1049	                input_ids_chunk = input_ids_chunks[idx_chunk] if input_ids_chunks else None
1050	            else:
1051	                # Shape ``(0, hidden_size)`` keeps dtype/device/column-width
1052	                # intact so routing / quantize / run_moe execute as no-ops
1053	                # without shape errors before reaching the barrier.
1054	                x_chunk = x_real.new_empty((0, x_real.shape[1]))
1055	                rl_chunk = rl_real.new_empty((0, rl_real.shape[1]))
1056	                input_ids_chunk = None
1057	
1058	            per_chunk_all_rank = (
1059	                [lst[idx_chunk] for lst in all_rank_chunk_size_list] if had_meta else None
1060	            )
1061	
1062	            out_chunk = self._forward_chunk(
1063	                x_chunk,
1064	                rl_chunk,
1065	                output_dtype=output_dtype,
1066	                all_rank_num_tokens=per_chunk_all_rank,
1067	                do_finalize=do_finalize,
1068	                is_first_call=is_first_call,
1069	                is_last_call=is_last_call,
1070	                input_ids=input_ids_chunk,
1071	            )
1072	            outputs.append(out_chunk)
1073	        return outputs
1074	
1075	    def _forward_chunk(
1076	        self,
1077	        x: Union[torch.Tensor, Fp4QuantizedTensor],
1078	        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
1079	        *,
1080	        output_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
1081	        all_rank_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]],
1082	        do_finalize: bool,
1083	        is_first_call: bool = True,
1084	        is_last_call: bool = True,
1085	        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
1086	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
1087	        """Run a single chunk through the fused-comm backend.
1088	
1089	        Inputs are already ADP-stripped by the caller; ``x.shape[0]`` is
1090	        the true unpadded per-rank token count for this chunk.
1091	        ``x.shape[0] == 0`` is valid: the kernel still launches so peers
1092	        can cross ``nvlink_barrier``.
1093	
1094	        EPLB hook ordering (matches ``ExternalCommMoEScheduler._forward_chunk_impl``):
1095	        ``start_wait_gpu_stage`` -> routing -> ``done_wait_gpu_stage`` ->
1096	        ``update_statistic(ignore_allreduce=False)`` -> ``route`` ->
1097	        quantize -> ``run_moe`` -> ``start_set_cpu_stage`` ->
1098	        ``done_set_cpu_stage``. ``start/done_set_cpu_stage`` are placed
1099	        AFTER ``run_moe``; otherwise dynamic-EPLB weight migration would
1100	        race with the fused kernel using those weights.
1101	        """
1102	        moe = self.moe
1103	        assert not moe.apply_router_weight_on_input, (
1104	            "Fused-comm MoE does not support apply_router_weight_on_input"
1105	        )
1106	        assert do_finalize, "Fused-comm MoE always finalizes inside the fused kernel"
1107	
1108	        if isinstance(x, Fp4QuantizedTensor):
1109	            raise NotImplementedError(
1110	                "Fused-comm MoE expects BF16 activation; "
1111	                "quantization happens in backend.quantize_input."
1112	            )
1113	        if output_dtype is None:
1114	            output_dtype = x.dtype
1115	
1116	        # Index per moe_ep_rank, not self.rank: SymmBuffer exchange is EP-scoped.
1117	        if all_rank_num_tokens is not None:
1118	            num_tokens = int(all_rank_num_tokens[moe.mapping.moe_ep_rank])
1119	        else:
1120	            num_tokens = x.shape[0]
1121	        assert num_tokens <= x.shape[0], f"num_tokens ({num_tokens}) > x.shape[0] ({x.shape[0]})"
1122	
1123	        x_chunk_real = x[:num_tokens]
1124	        router_logits_chunk_real = router_logits[:num_tokens]
1125	        input_ids_chunk_real = input_ids[:num_tokens] if input_ids is not None else None
1126	
1127	        # ----- EPLB: drain previous CPU rebalance -----
1128	        # Static EPLB early-returns inside the helper; only the dynamic
1129	        # balancer actually waits.
1130	        moe._load_balancer_start_wait_gpu_stage(is_first_call)
1131	
1132	        # ----- routing -----
1133	        # int32 matches the EPLB stats kernel contract used by the external-comm
1134	        # path; the fused-comm backend casts to int64 internally.
1135	        if num_tokens > 0:
1136	            token_selected_experts, token_final_scales = moe.routing_method.apply(
1137	                router_logits_chunk_real, input_ids_chunk_real
1138	            )
1139	            token_selected_experts = token_selected_experts.to(torch.int32)
1140	            token_final_scales = token_final_scales.to(torch.float32)
1141	        else:
1142	            device = x.device
1143	            token_selected_experts = torch.empty(
1144	                (0, moe.routing_method.experts_per_token),
1145	                dtype=torch.int32,
1146	                device=device,
1147	            )
1148	            token_final_scales = torch.empty(
1149	                (0, moe.routing_method.experts_per_token),
1150	                dtype=torch.float32,
1151	                device=device,
1152	            )
1153	
1154	        # ----- EPLB: update stats + remap expert ids -> slot ids -----
1155	        if moe.layer_load_balancer:
1156	            moe._load_balancer_done_wait_gpu_stage(is_first_call)
1157	            # ignore_allreduce=False: the fused kernel has no side channel
1158	            # for an external stats gather. The base helper runs its own
1159	            # EP-wide AllReduce, gated to is_last_call=True.
1160	            moe._load_balancer_update_statistic(
1161	                token_selected_experts,
1162	                is_first_call,
1163	                is_last_call,
1164	                ignore_allreduce=False,
1165	            )
1166	            token_selected_slots = moe._load_balancer_route(token_selected_experts, moe.use_dp)
1167	        else:
1168	            token_selected_slots = token_selected_experts
1169	
1170	        if token_selected_slots is not None:
1171	            ExpertStatistic.set_layer(moe.layer_idx)
1172	            ExpertStatistic.maybe_add_info(moe.num_slots, token_selected_slots)
1173	        token_selected_slots = get_calibrator().maybe_collect_or_replay_slots(
1174	            moe.num_slots, token_selected_slots
1175	        )
1176	
1177	        # ----- quantize / prepare -----
1178	        if getattr(moe.backend, "supports_fused_prepare", lambda: False)():
1179	            # MegaMoE can fuse BF16->MXFP8 quantization with the SymmBuffer
1180	            # topk copies, so keep the original activations and let run_moe
1181	            # prepare its workspace.
1182	            moe_input = x_chunk_real
1183	            x_sf = None
1184	        else:
1185	            # Delegate to ``backend.quantize_input`` so each fused-comm backend
1186	            # owns its own empty-tensor layout. Both MegaMoEDeepGemm and
1187	            # MegaMoECuteDsl short-circuit ``x.shape[0] == 0`` inside their
1188	            # quantize_input contracts.
1189	            moe_input, x_sf = moe.backend.quantize_input(x_chunk_real)
1190	
1191	        # ----- MoE compute -----
1192	        # ``token_selected_slots`` is in [0, num_slots), matching the kernel's
1193	        # ``num_experts`` template parameter (SymmBuffer / weights sized to
1194	        # num_slots in quantization.py).
1195	        out = moe.backend.run_moe(
1196	            x=moe_input,
1197	            token_selected_experts=token_selected_slots,
1198	            token_final_scales=token_final_scales,
1199	            x_sf=x_sf,
1200	            output_dtype=output_dtype,
1201	        )
1202	
1203	        # ----- EPLB: start/done CPU rebalance, AFTER run_moe -----
1204	        # The external-comm path overlaps CPU stage with ``comm.combine``;
1205	        # fused-comm has no external combine, so start_set fires
1206	        # immediately after the fused kernel and done_set drains it. Placing
1207	        # start_set before run_moe would let dynamic-EPLB migration race the
1208	        # kernel.
1209	        moe._load_balancer_start_set_cpu_stage(is_last_call)
1210	        moe._load_balancer_done_set_cpu_stage(is_last_call)
1211	
1212	        return out
1213	
1214	
1215	# ============================================================================
1216	# Factory
1217	# ============================================================================
1218	
1219	
1220	def create_moe_scheduler(moe: "ConfigurableMoE") -> MoEScheduler:
1221	    """Pick the scheduler matching ``moe.backend.scheduler_kind``."""
1222	    kind = moe.backend.scheduler_kind
1223	    if kind == MoESchedulerKind.FUSED_COMM:
1224	        return FusedCommMoEScheduler(moe)
1225	    if kind == MoESchedulerKind.EXTERNAL_COMM:
1226	        return ExternalCommMoEScheduler(moe)
1227	    raise ValueError(
1228	        f"Unknown MoE scheduler kind {kind!r} on backend "
1229	        f"{type(moe.backend).__name__}. Set ``scheduler_kind`` to one of "
1230	        f"{[k.name for k in MoESchedulerKind]}."
1231	    )
